name: 00 | AI Lead Automation | Local Data Tables Setup

parameters.content:
# 00 — Local state setup
Run this workflow once after import. It creates two n8n Data Tables used for idempotency and audit logging.

If a table already exists, the create node is allowed to continue so rerunning setup is safe.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{ok:true,message:'Setup finished. Ensure Data Tables lead_automation_state and lead_automation_audit exist before publishing the main workflow.'}}];

name: 01 | AI Lead Automation | Twenty Connectivity Check

parameters.content: # 01 — Twenty connectivity check\nRead-only verification of Bearer authentication and access to People + Opportunities. No records are created or changed.

parameters.jsCode: const err=$json.error?(typeof $json.error==='string'?$json.error:JSON.stringify($json.error)):''; if(err) throw new Error('Twenty People API failed: '+err); return [{json:{people_ok:true}}];

const err=$json.error?(typeof $json.error==='string'?$json.error:JSON.stringify($json.error)):''; if(err) throw new Error('Twenty Opportunities API failed: '+err); return [{json:{status:'ok',provider:'Twenty CRM',auth:'Bearer credential',people_api:true,opportunities_api:true,checked_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

name: 02 | AI Lead Qualification & CRM Automation | Production-like

parameters.content:
# 02 - AI Lead Qualification + Twenty CRM
Production-like local stack: n8n -> Twenty CRM -> Mailpit.

Twenty Person and Opportunity records include portfolio CRM fields: Lead Score, Lead Category, Service, Source, AI Summary and Request ID; Person also stores Budget and Company Size.

Independent switches: mockAI=true, mockCRM=false, mockEmail=false, mockNotification=false.

return [{json:{http_code:$json.http_code||200,body:{status:$json.duplicate_reason,request_id:$json.request_id,previous:$json.existing_state||null}}}];

name: 03 | AI Lead Automation | Calendly Booking Handler

parameters.content: # 03 — Calendly → Twenty Opportunity\nReceives invitee.created, finds the persisted lead by email, and updates its Twenty opportunity. The workflow introspects OpportunityStageEnum first instead of hard-coding a stage.

parameters.jsCode: const code=$json.is_booking?422:200; return [{json:{http_code:code,body:{status:$json.is_booking?'invalid_booking_event':'ignored',event:$json.event_type,email:$json.email||null}}}];
return [{json:{http_code:202,body:{status:'accepted_no_deal',email:$json.email,request_id:$json.request_id||null}}}];
return [{json:{...$json,deal_update_ok:true,deal_update_status:'mock_updated'}}];
return [{json:{http_code:200,body:{status:'meeting_scheduled',request_id:$json.request_id,deal_id:$json.deal_id,start_time:$json.start_time||null,mode:$json.deal_update_status}}}];
return [{json:{http_code:502,body:{status:'failed',request_id:$json.request_id,deal_id:$json.deal_id,error:$json.deal_update_error||'Deal stage update failed'}}}];

name: 04 | AI Lead Automation | Global Error Handler

parameters.content:
# 04 — Global error workflow
After import, open the main workflow and Calendly workflow settings and select this workflow under **Error workflow**.

The Error Trigger is intentionally not connected to external notification APIs: the handler must remain low-risk and should not recursively fail because a third-party service is down.

# 05 - Portfolio demo form
Serves a self-contained local web UI at `/webhook/portfolio/demo`.

The browser submits to the existing workflow 02 via the relative path `/webhook/portfolio/lead`, so the dynamic n8n host port requires no hardcoded configuration.
